description: ER-01 (Petra PO -> vendor confirmation segment) on the general path: one host capture cycle (operating.host: the purchase-order Portal relations into the source mirror, the BC purchaseOrders of every pinned company, the eight purchasing and operations mailboxes of examples/case_mail_purchasing_capture_scope.live-check.json through the GET-only Graph reader, bounded at 600 s of mail capture), then offline over those captures: pick=PurchaseOrder+SupplierConfirmation (the newest purchase order the investigator may read from which a supplier confirmation is reached within two links; a machine-read document reference is a lead, so the pick asks again at lead tier when the tool says the link is below its floor) is opened through the generic tools, and the chain plan (ontology/plans/chain.json) walks from the PO and its twins along every mention link the schema declares into their type from a document-field type (supplier confirmations, packing slips, freight bills, forwarder quotes ...), every one followed at lead tier and labelled lead_tier_links_followed; a document's mailed and filed copies with the same bytes count once. cases[*].pick.lead_tier says the root was chosen only through a lead-tier link. Customer PO -> Petra PO stays mail-mention leads only (no PO<->SO reference upstream). The workspace is rendered for the investigator and a reader without any grant here. Counts and enums only, never an identifier or value.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; the module test is injected-transport (tests/test_investigate_chain_documents.py: the spec's own command, its host config copied with a books map that pins the fixture companies, over the in-process FakeWorkbench, FakeBc and FakeGraph; its expectations checked on the real summary; a supplier confirmation mailed to a purchasing mailbox other than the shared purchase-order inbox is captured and picked, and a principal the live audience does not list sees none of it through plx.object, plx.around, plx.find, plx.documents or plx.investigate; a Portal answering HTTP 500 at capture meets expect_blocked). relationship_edges counts, per reader, the projection's ontology links around the case by schema link type, as that reader's plx.object and plx.around show them (SupplierConfirmation.confirms and the other document links among them when the pick found one); relationship_truncated names what the bounded read left out. Expected honest failures, named in cases[*].missing (the pick's typed cause): pick_linked_absent when no supplier confirmation was captured while every source of the type was captured in full (the window is the mailboxes' last 90 days; run 2026-10-14 failed this way while the scope was the shared purchase-order inbox alone, 3 messages in 1 folder), pick_linked_unjoined when the ones captured name no purchase order the capture holds, pick_source_not_captured:<source> when either while a capture unit of that source, or for an unjoined pick of the linked type's source, did not finish (run 2026-10-15: 2 of 10 mail folders read and pick_linked_unjoined, which now names graph_mail) (a BC company's purchaseOrders: the PO may be the one it missed; graph_mail when the 600 s mail budget left a folder unread: each run starts from an empty state, so a scope larger than one budget stays incomplete), pick_not_reached when the investigator's tools reach none. Daily: eight Portal relations (900 s budget), the BC purchase orders of three companies (600 s) and eight mailboxes, ten folders (600 s) share the 2400 s timeout (seconds.capture/open/render are recorded so the first run measures it). stderr_causes counts by typed cause what the run would have written to stderr (library logging records such as pypdf's on a malformed mailed PDF, and warnings), never a message: run 2026-10-15 left 33 unparsed stderr lines. cases[*].pick of a linked pick counts candidates, candidates_joined, linked_held, linked_to_start (held linked objects with a direct link to a start-type object; the pick also joins through one intermediate) and linked_refs_unheld (held linked documents whose stated PO reference, a refers_to field such as a confirmation's 'Your PO', no held object answers: a PO the capture missed or a misread number), so an unjoined pick named by an unfinished capture still measures the join. A held confirmation naming a PO no held object answers is pick_linked_unjoined only once the captures of both sides finished; while the mail capture is unfinished the cause is pick_source_not_captured:graph_mail (a confirmation it missed may name a held PO; the unheld reference is still counted in linked_refs_unheld), and while mail is refused it is blocked_upstream:graph_mail (decision 2026-10-19-pick-cause-mail-unfinished). stderr_causes counts pypdf's records where pypdf reads (the reading's warnings name them pypdf_log:<LEVEL>); any other logging record, a logged traceback included, still reaches stderr. A source whose latest host read was refused outright (live 2026-10-18: Graph answered 403 on every mailbox lookup, the app lacking User.Read.All) is listed in blocked_upstream (mail.mailbox_lookup with the permission), and a pick that found nothing while a source of its linked or picked type was refused is blocked (blocked_upstream:graph_mail), never failed: expect_blocked until the grant is in place. capture.projection.reference_alias (A10, decision 2026-10-19-reference-alias-leads) reports the supplier-number alias join of the build: outcome alias_joined when a document's mention links now through a person's reviewed alias (reviewed_alias_links_open; reviewed_alias_links also counts stretches closed by a later reject_alias), alias_lead_pending when a supplier's own number (vendor_confirmation, pi_ref) no record answers was read in a mail whose PO link is corroborated (alias_leads; a lead joins nothing until plx.review records the alias), else the typed reason no candidate was found: alias_rejected (a reject_alias holds), several_targets, no_corroborated_target (alias_no_candidate counts each), no_supplier_number, or mentions_not_run; alias_numbers counts the unanswered supplier numbers read. Module evidence for it is isolated-fixture (ontology/tests/test_mentions.py) and injected-transport (tests/test_investigate_chain_documents.py runs this spec's command and checks its expectations on the real summary). Run 2026-10-20 (f956623): BC complete, mail 6 of 10 folders, no confirmation held: pick_source_not_captured:graph_mail with no case. Since case-po-pick-live a capture-state cause (pick_source_not_captured:<source>, or pick_source_not_configured:<source> when no confirmation is held while a source of the type the host config never captures, sharepoint here, could hold one) roots the newest readable purchase order with a pick_linked_not_captured gap (not_ingested): status unlinked, counted in cases_unlinked and failed, never in cases_rendered, so the run stays red (exit 1, 'cases_rendered < 1') naming the source in cases[*].missing; pick_linked_unjoined and pick_not_reached open no case. A recorded mail refusal (403 mailbox lookup) stays blocked_upstream:graph_mail, never unlinked.
